notes: Panel/layout and GUI cleanup. 0.8.6.45 moves the equipped weapon text to its own full-width row below the 'Оружие:' label, increases the default panel height, and migrates the geometry key so old 435px geometry does not clip the new row. It also fixes the xai_mod_boot notice flag mismatch that caused the 0.8.6.44 activation line to spam on every GUI event. Finally, evn_modgui no longer calls epc_modgui unconditionally; EPC is chained only when EPC was actually the module's original GUI handler, avoiding Interlude sqlite errors about the missing nui_forms table. Combat core 0.7.10.7, reader, Plada/FIX5 and Dorna class/profile are unchanged.
